title: split-lint-pipelines-introduce-lightweight-lint-worker-and-tidy-build-deps
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Refactors CI: splits lint and test workflows, introduces lightweight lint worker, upgrades dev deps, and tidies build bootstrapping. No runtime changes.
body:
Summary: This PR refactors the repository CI and build tooling to reduce noise on pull requests, speed up feedback for incremental changes, and consolidate legacy bootstrap scripts. Primary goals: 1) split linting into a fast path (quick checks run on PRs) and a heavy/periodic path (full linters and typechecks run nightly), 2) add a lightweight lint worker that uses a cached container to avoid installing dev deps on every runner, 3) tidy and pin a set of developer dependencies used by build and lint scripts, and 4) collapse several legacy npm/python bootstrap shims into a single hermetic bootstrap script.

Why: PRs were frequently blocked or delayed by lengthy linter/typecheck runs and repeated dependency installs. Teams wanted fast red/green on critical checks while keeping full verification on a controlled cadence to catch regressions.

Changes (high level):
- CI: introduced .github/workflows/lint-fast.yml (runs eslint --cache, static-checks, and a subset of unit linters) and .github/workflows/lint-nightly.yml (runs full eslint, typecheck, stylelint, and flake8). The fast workflow is required on PRs; the nightly is scheduled and triggers on release branches.
- CI: added .github/workflows/ci-bootstrap-cache.yml to warm a reusable container image with pinned dev deps (node, python wheels) so the lightweight lint worker can start within ~20s.
- Tooling: added scripts/bootstrapping/bootstrap.sh which consolidates repo-wide setup steps (node install, poetry venv, gitattributes checks). Deprecated legacy scripts in tools/legacy-bootstrap/ (moved to archive).
- Deps: updated devDependencies in package.json (eslint 9.16.0 -> 9.19.0, typescript 4.9.5 -> 5.2.2), pinned pytest plugins, and added a dev-deps-lock.txt for reproducible installs in the CI container.
- Build: small harmonization of Makefile targets and added a hermetic test shim at tools/test-shim/run_tests.sh to minimize environment drift in CI.
- Repo hygiene: removed obsolete scripts/ci/travis-compat.*, removed a couple of duplicate logrotate configs under infra/.

Commits: See commits list below for atomic changes.

Files changed (representative):
- .github/workflows/lint-fast.yml
- .github/workflows/lint-nightly.yml
- .github/workflows/ci-bootstrap-cache.yml
- scripts/bootstrapping/bootstrap.sh
- package.json
- dev-deps-lock.txt
- tools/test-shim/run_tests.sh
- Makefile (minor targets)
- tools/legacy-bootstrap/* (moved to tools/legacy-bootstrap/archive/)

Checklist:
- [x] Split fast vs full lint pipelines
- [x] Add cached bootstrap container build
- [x] Pin dev deps and add lock file for CI
- [x] Migrate legacy scripts and add deprecation note
- [x] Update README CI section with new expectations

Testing and CI:
- Iteration 1: initial push wired up workflows; first lint-fast run passed but nightly failed due to an eslint-plugin peer dependency conflict.
- Iteration 2: bumped eslint-plugin-import to resolve conflict and re-ran; lint-nightly passed on the scheduled run.
- Iteration 3: added a small unit test fix for a renamed helper affected by typescript upgrade; re-ran full test matrix.
- Final CI: all required checks passed (see ci_checks). Cache warming reduced bootstrap time on PR runs from ~180s to ~30s.

Review notes:
- The fast lint workflow intentionally narrows rules to low-risk stylistic checks to provide quick feedback; teams are expected to follow up with the nightly run results for enforcement.
- Dev dependency pins are documented in dev-deps-lock.txt and will be refreshed quarterly via the dependency-health-gate process.
- No production packages were changed; runtime deps untouched.

Merger: Squash-and-merge after approvals and a green fast-lint check in the final run. Merged by Samir Gupta.

review_thread:
Priya: The split is helpful. Can we add an explicit eslint ruleset file for the fast pipeline so teams know which rules run on PRs?
Maya: Yep — added .eslintrc.fast.json and referenced it in lint-fast.yml.
Elliot: CI bootstrap cache looks good; can we add a cache invalidation tag strategy?
Maya: Implemented a short-lived tag strategy based on dev-deps-lock.txt hash; documented in workflows and bootstrap.sh.
Priya: Found a flaky test after the TS bump — test/test_utils::test_normalize started failing on CI.
Maya: Fixed the test to account for the new normalization behavior and added a comment.
Elliot: Approved after re-run.
Samir: Squash-merged on green.
